description: Agent impersonation: origin authorizes a task to agent B bound to B's cryptographic identity; a rogue agent C claims B's agent-ID string.

rule.name: INV-02_identity_binding
rule.description: The authorization basis binds the delegatee's cryptographic identity, not an agent-ID string

action.reason: executing agent's identity does not match the bound cryptographic identity (INV-02 identity binding)
